description:
HushThreads v0.0.11 has 11 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (com.instagram.barcelona). It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1. New in this one is Pure black dark mode, which puts your feed, posts and profiles on true black in dark mode. It isn't selected by default, so tick it when you patch. The patches are Hide ads, Hide suggested users, Block background-return feed refresh, Disable video autoplay, Pure black dark mode, Sanitize sharing links, Open links in browser, Disable analytics, Remove the advertising ID, Restore screens on re-signed builds and HushThreads settings.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

Validation: 518 runtime tests passed locally. All 191 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 11 patches applied to Threads 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85 without forcing, and the release receipt records both runs.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 449.0.0.54.82, version code 511908382. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
